title: DNA Extraction from Sterivex Filters
author: Colleen Kellogg
materials: Remove the parafilm and remove Longmire’s buffer/SLB using a syringe. You can use a plastic “tripour” to dispose the buffer and then pour all of the volume in the sink. Rinse the tripour with water after use, dry and wipe it down using a paper towel and PREempt solution.
Inject 720 μL ATL buffer into the Sterivex.

We are aiming to do about 24 samples per day, but you can aim for less than that until you get comfortable with the protocol. Materials needed: Proteinase K, 2mL Qiagen Catalog #19131 0.5 mm glass beads, silica. Molecular grade Molecular grade ethanol (100%) QIAgen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit, 50 rxn Qiagen Catalog #69504 The kit Includes: ATL (lysis buffer) AL (lysis buffer) RNAse AW1 (Wash buffer) AW2 (Wash buffer) AE (Elution buffer) Spin Columns

steps.title: Prepare reagents and aliquots
steps.instruction: Set aside ATL buffer, AL buffer, proteinase K, RNase A, and anhydrous ethanol. Place ATL and AL buffers in the incubator to eliminate any precipitate. Note storage locations (ATL/AL in incubator, proteinase‑K aliquots (enough for 12 samples) in a cardboard box in the mini‑freezer, ethanol in CR1 mini fridge and CR2 mini freezer). Calculate the volume of each reagent needed, prepare one‑time‑use aliquot tubes with a slight excess, and make the aliquots inside the HEPA‑filtered workstation.

substeps.instruction: Gather ATL buffer, AL buffer, proteinase K, RNase A, and anhydrous ethanol.
Place ATL and AL buffers in the incubator to melt any precipitate.
Calculate required volumes for each reagent.
Prepare one‑time‑use aliquot tubes with a slight excess inside the HEPA workstation.

steps.title: Clean work area and set incubator
steps.instruction: Wipe down benches, centrifuge, and all working surfaces with PREempt solution/wipes. Turn on the incubator and set the temperature to 56 °C.

steps.title: Dry Sterivex inlet if needed
steps.instruction: If the Sterivex inlet is wet, dry it with a single Kimwipe per filter and place the filter on a clean Kimwipe while preparing additional filters.

steps.title: Add silica beads to Sterivex
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 mm silica beads (~0.3 g, approximately three white spoons) into each Sterivex using a weighting‑paper funnel (one per Sterivex).

steps.title: Seal outlet with parafilm
steps.instruction: Cut parafilm to 1 cm × 5 cm and place two or three pieces on the outlet port of each Sterivex filter unit, then seal the outlet.

steps.title: Prepare extraction blank
steps.instruction: Prepare one additional Sterivex containing ATL buffer only to serve as an extraction blank for contamination monitoring.

steps.title: First bead‑beating cycle
steps.instruction: Place each Sterivex in the vortex adapter and bead‑beat for 10 min to promote cell lysis.

steps.title: First incubation at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Insert each Sterivex into a 50 mL conical tube and incubate at 56 °C for 30 min while tilting or rotating the tube.

steps.title: Repeat bead‑beat and incubation
steps.instruction: Repeat the 10‑min bead‑beating and the subsequent 30‑min incubation at 56 °C once more.

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL proteinase‑K to each Sterivex.

steps.title: Reseal outlet if leaking
steps.instruction: If lysate is observed leaking, reseal the outlet port with fresh parafilm.

steps.title: Mix and incubate 2 h
steps.instruction: Vortex the tubes for ~10 s (or gently mix), return Sterivexes to their 50 mL tubes, and incubate at 56 °C for 2 h while rotating.

steps.title: Prepare labeled loBind tube
steps.instruction: While the Sterivexes warm, prepare a 2.0 mL lo‑Bind DNA tube, label the cap with sample information, and set it aside.

steps.title: Remove parafilm and inlet fitting
steps.instruction: After the 2‑hour incubation, carefully remove the parafilm and the Luer fitting from the inlet port, avoiding loss of liquid.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to loBind tube
steps.instruction: Insert the inlet port into the labeled 2.0 mL tube, push it down to the bottom of the 50 mL conical tube, and firmly close the conical tube cap.

steps.title: Centrifuge to collect lysate
steps.instruction: Place the conical tubes in Megafuge adapters and centrifuge at 6,000 × g for 1 min. The DNA‑containing lysate will collect in the 2.0 mL tube.

steps.title: Retrieve tubes and clean tweezers
steps.instruction: Using tweezers, remove the 50 mL conical tube, then remove the Sterivex filter unit and the uncapped 2.0 mL tube. Wipe tweezers with PREempt wipes between samples.

steps.title: Discard waste and cap lysate
steps.instruction: Discard the used 50 mL conical tubes (keep one as a provisional waste container) and the Sterivex units. Firmly cap the 2.0 mL tube; this tube now contains the lysate.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL RNase A (100 mg/mL) to the lysate, mix by pipetting up/down or vortexing, and incubate at room temperature for 2 min.

steps.title: Add buffer AL and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL buffer AL, mix thoroughly (precipitate may form), and incubate at 56 °C for 10 min (no rotisserie needed).

steps.title: Add ethanol and mix
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethanol (96‑100 %), mix thoroughly; total volume should be approximately 1.2 mL.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column (first)
steps.instruction: Pipette 600 µL of the mixture into a DNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube. Centrifuge at 8,000 rpm (~6,000 × g) for 1 min and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous loading step with the remaining lysate (second 600 µL load).

steps.title: Wash column with AW1
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube. If buffer remains, centrifuge again at ~10,000 × g; repeat at higher speed if needed. Add 500 µL buffer AW1, centrifuge 1 min at 8,000 rpm (~6,000 × g), discard flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with AW2
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a fresh 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL buffer AW2, centrifuge 30 s at 14,000 rpm (~20,000 × g), discard flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Transfer column to microtube
steps.instruction: Move the spin column to a new 1.5 mL or 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA with buffer AE
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL buffer AE to the centre of the membrane, incubate 1 min at room temperature, then centrifuge 1 min at 8,000 rpm (~6,000 × g) to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Optional second elution
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous elution step with another 200 µL buffer AE to increase DNA yield, if desired.

steps.title: UV decontaminate consumables
steps.instruction: UV‑decontaminate all tubes, beads, and consumables for 30 min (e.g., a 5 mL tube of silica beads for up to 12 samples, 2 mL tubes, 50 mL Falcon tubes, racks, pipettes, and pipette tips).
